I build data pipelines and turn messy data into decisions people can act on.
Right now I am finishing my M.S. in Data Science at **Willamette University**,
where my capstone [predicts the category of school that a student will attend](capstone.qmd) for
the Willamette University Admissions and Enrollment Management Teams.

I care about supporting communities, education, public service, data governance, ethical data practices, reproducible workflows, and proper communication to teammembers and stakeholders. 

**Currently looking for**  Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Data Engineer roles. [Get in touch](about.qmd) or grab my
[resume](resume.qmd).
